title: Hypothermia
summary: Handle gently, prevent further heat loss, warm the core gradually, and monitor breathing carefully.
sources: 2025 American Heart Association Guidelines for CPR and Emergency Cardiovascular Care — Hypothermia
European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025 — First Aid
actions: Move to shelter, remove wet clothing carefully, dry the person, and insulate from the ground and wind.
Handle gently and keep the person horizontal when possible. Warm the trunk with dry layers, blankets, and warm packs wrapped in cloth to the chest, armpits, and groin.
If fully alert and able to swallow, offer warm sweet non-alcoholic drinks.
Check breathing for up to 1 minute because severe hypothermia can cause very slow breathing. If no normal breathing, start CPR and use an AED.
Call emergency services for moderate or severe signs, injury, immersion, or failure to improve.
prohibitions: Do not rub or massage cold limbs.
Do not use a hot bath, direct flame, or unwrapped heat source.
Do not assume a very cold unresponsive person is dead.

emergencyCall.text: Confusion, drowsiness, stopped shivering, abnormal breathing, or reduced responsiveness requires emergency services.
